Frequently Asked Questions

What are ULIPs and should I invest in them?

ULIPs (Unit Linked Insurance Plans) combine life insurance with market-linked investments (equity/debt/balanced). They offer tax benefits, fund switching, and transparency. Suitable for long-term goals (10+ years) with risk appetite. We compare ULIPs vs mutual funds + term insurance.

Are ULIPs better than mutual funds?

ULIPs have insurance component, tax benefits under 80C/10(10D), and fund switching without tax. Mutual funds offer lower costs, higher liquidity, and better fund variety. For pure investment, mutual funds + separate term insurance often wins. We provide side-by-side comparison.
